title: The Witness
text: A shepherd sits on a rock with his flock, chewing a stalk of grass. He saw the Lost pass a week ago, he says, and for a price he will tell you which way they went. His sheep never take their eyes off you.

options.label: Pay the shepherd; a week's head start is worth the coin.

outcomes.text: He points the way. The sheep watch you go.

options.label: The smoothest charms it out of him, along with whatever else he saw.

outcomes.text: He tells it for free, with more besides.

options.label: The strongest frightens it out of him; there is no time to bargain.

outcomes.text: He points the wrong way. The sheep know it.
